meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能帮你浏览、选择并提交 Ginkgo Bioworks 云实验室的自动化实验方案，包括蛋白表达纯化、定量、IVT RNA 合成、热稳定性分析等，还能通过 EstiMate 询问定制方案。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo 云实验室运行蛋白表达纯化、定量、IVT RNA 合成、热稳定性分析、Echo-MS 检测、SPR 靶点对接或荧光像素画等实验时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交一个细胞-free蛋白表达HiBiT定量的订单。
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择方案、配置参数并提交。

say.text: 用EstiMate评估一下我的定制实验方案。
say.note: Claude 会打开 EstiMate 页面让你描述方案。

say.text: 我想做IVT mRNA合成，需要准备什么？
say.note: Claude 会列出该方案的输入要求和流程。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you browse, select, and submit protocols for Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab, including protein expression/purification, quantification, IVT RNA synthesis, thermal shift assays, and more. It can also use EstiMate for custom protocol inquiries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run protein expression/purification, quantification, IVT RNA synthesis, thermal shift assays, Echo-MS detection, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or other Ginkgo Cloud Lab services.

say_en.text: Help me submit an order for cell-free protein expression with HiBiT quantification.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through protocol selection, configuration, and submission.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to evaluate my custom protocol.
say_en.note: Claude will open the EstiMate page for you to describe your protocol.

say_en.text: What do I need to prepare for IVT mRNA synthesis?
say_en.note: Claude will list the inputs and workflow for that protocol.
